response.sql: WITH team_totals AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id), benchmarks AS (SELECT SUM(total_games) AS all_games, AVG(total_games) AS avg_team_games FROM team_totals) SELECT t.team_id, t.total_games, 1.0 * t.total_games / NULLIF(b.all_games, 0) AS fraction_of_all_games, 1.0 * t.total_games / NULLIF(b.avg_team_games, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM team_totals AS t CROSS JOIN benchmarks AS b ORDER BY ratio_to_average IS NULL, ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
